run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence criterion loss between frame-level input and token-level target
create_GTNLossFunction: create a custom PyTorch autograd Function using GTN graphs for sequence alignment loss computation
build_make_target_graph: build a target graph where each token can align to one or more input frames using gtn.Graph
test_forward_backward: test the forward and backward pass of GTNLossFunction with batched inputs and targets
review_parallel_for: review the use of gtn.parallel_for to compute loss and gradients in parallel across a batch
